## What this lands

- **`web/tests/e2e/capstone-journalist.spec.ts`** — the J1–J5 journey battery,
  walked cold from `/` once per {390, 1440 px} × {JS on, JS off} cell. Every
  journey resolves its targets from the served site itself (the A–Z directory
  supplies the dossier route, the dossier's own explore bar the scoped graph
  URL, the disagreements index the contested place, the feed directory the
  `.atom`) — nothing fixture-specific is hard-coded, so the identical spec
  runs against the promoted origin. J1: figure → breakdown → rows download
  (unit, denominator, "not a census", as-of, release id; evidence ≤ 2
  actions). J2: typeahead → Texas dossier → explore bar → scoped graph view
  (named nodes or typed absence); the no-JS leg proves the GET form contract,
  the A–Z path, the `/graphs/access/usa/tx/` edge rows (dated-or-"undated",
  historical marked, sources named) and the entity pages. J3: the ≠
  contested marker → one click to the typed-kind disagreements surface →
  both sides of the recorded contradiction. J4: the Cite block carries the
  as-of pair + ruleset, the interim "not yet published" sentence, and the
  legacy `?as_of_world=` URL resolves within the 200/404/409 contract — the
  durable `/s/<pub>/` half rides ACT-24, asserted never claimed. J5:
  `/changes/` keeps "The world changed" and "SIG's records changed" apart;
  per-place/per-source `.atom` + OPML resolve.
- **`web/playwright.capstone-journalist.config.ts`** — the dedicated
  four-project runner (`capstone-1440-js`, `capstone-390-js`,
  `capstone-1440-nojs`, `capstone-390-nojs`).
  `SIG_CAPSTONE_BASE_URL=<promoted-origin>` skips the preview server and
  points the battery at the promoted release — a fixture/preview pass is
  never reported as a live/public pass.
- **`ops/src/ops/capstone_journalist.py` + `sig-ops capstone-journalist`** —
  the `sig.capstone-journalist/1` leg declaration: `journeys-fixture` and
  `cost-ledger` deterministic legs run in this dispatch; `live-journeys`,

  `cost-ledger` emits a `sig.capstone-cost-read/1` over the committed spend

- **`docs/build/reports/p37.68b-capstone/`** — `PACKET.md` + `packet.json`

- **DEFERRALS `### P37.68b`** — `D-P37.68b-1` (kind V: the promoted-release
